description: This file is a header file (.h) for image utilities used in an object tracking module within TensorFlow's Android tools. It contains function declarations and inline implementations for image processing tasks such as UV channel extraction, marking circular regions in images, calculating image gradients, cross-correlation, copying image regions, and normalization.

void MarkImage(const int x,const int y,const int radius,Image<U> * const img)
